title: Storybound world rule
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/world_rules/<path>.json. World-level rules managed in Dev Mode's World Setup tab: item locks, mob spawn locks, place locks, and general loot modifiers.

oneOf.title: Item lock
oneOf.description: Locks items or item tags until the unlock conditions pass.

title.description: Optional label shown in the World Setup editor (never shown to players).

enabled.description: Whether this rule is active. Turn off to disable it without deleting.

items.description: Locked items: an item id, a #tag (#minecraft:swords), or a list of them.

unlock.description: Story conditions that unlock these items. While empty or unmet, the items stay locked.

block_use.description: Block right-clicking with the item and mining blocks with it.

block_attack.description: Block attacking entities while holding the item.

block_equip.description: Block wearing the item in armor slots or holding it in the offhand.

block_craft.description: Block taking the item from a crafting result slot.

block_pickup.description: Block picking the item up from the ground.

hide_in_jei.description: Hide these items from JEI while they are locked for the player.

message.description: Shown in the item tooltip and action bar while locked. Empty: uses a default locked message.

oneOf.title: Mob spawn lock
oneOf.description: Prevents mobs from spawning (or replaces them) until nearby players pass the unlock conditions.

title.description: Optional label shown in the World Setup editor (never shown to players).

enabled.description: Whether this rule is active. Turn off to disable it without deleting.

entities.description: Locked mobs: an entity id, a #tag (#minecraft:undead), or a list of them.

dimension.description: Only in this dimension (empty: any dimension).

biome.description: Only in these biomes: an id, a #tag, or a list.

structure.description: Only inside these structures: an id, a #tag, or a list.

unlock.description: Story conditions checked for nearby players (within 128 blocks). While nobody nearby satisfies them (or when empty), the spawn is blocked.

despawn_existing.description: Remove already-existing matching mobs in loaded chunks (and when chunks load). Never removes custom-named, tamed, leashed, summoned, or Storybound NPC/boss entities.

block_spawners.description: Also block monster spawners and trial spawners (otherwise only natural, chunk, patrol, and reinforcement spawns are blocked).

replace_with.description: Optional mob to spawn instead when this mob is blocked (e.g. minecraft:zombie).

oneOf.title: Place lock
oneOf.description: Restricts entering a dimension, biome, or structure until the unlock conditions pass.

title.description: Optional label shown in the World Setup editor (never shown to players).

enabled.description: Whether this rule is active. Turn off to disable it without deleting.

dimension.description: Locked dimension (or limit the biome/structure check to this dimension).

biome.description: Locked biomes: an id, a #tag, or a list.

structure.description: Locked structures: an id, a #tag, or a list.

unlock.description: Story conditions that allow entering this place. While empty or unmet, the lock applies.

mode.description: barrier: blocks dimension travel and pushes players back out of locked biomes or structures. hazard: lets players enter but applies effects and/or damage while inside.

effects.description: Hazard mode only: status effects applied while inside the locked place.

damage.description: Hazard mode only: magic damage dealt every second while inside (2 = 1 heart; 0 = no direct damage).

message.description: Shown in the action bar when blocked or warned. Empty: uses a default locked message.

oneOf.title: Loot modifier
oneOf.description: Adds, replaces, or removes any items in chests, loot tables, or mob drops.

title.description: Optional label shown in the World Setup editor (never shown to players).

enabled.description: Whether this rule is active. Turn off to disable it without deleting.

operation.description: add: appends the item to generated loot. replace: replaces matching items in generated loot. remove: strips matching items from generated loot.

tables.description: Specific loot tables (e.g. minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon). When both tables and entities are empty, matches any chest loot table.

entities.description: Mob drops: an entity id, a #tag (#minecraft:undead), or a list of mobs whose loot is modified.

dimension.description: Only in this dimension (empty: any dimension).

biome.description: Only in these biomes: an id, a #tag, or a list.

structure.description: Only inside these structures: an id, a #tag, or a list.

conditions.description: Optional story conditions checked for the player opening the chest or killing the mob.

once.description: none: can trigger repeatedly. player: at most once per player. world: at most once in the whole world.

target.description: For replace and remove: items to match (an item id, a #tag, or a list).

item.description: For add and replace: the item id to add or replace with.

min_count.description: For add and replace: minimum stack count.

max_count.description: For add and replace: maximum stack count.

components.description: Optional Minecraft item data components (enchantments, custom name, etc.).

effect.description: Status effect id (e.g. minecraft:wither, minecraft:blindness, minecraft:slowness).

amplifier.description: Effect level minus one (0 = I, 1 = II, 2 = III).

duration.description: Effect duration in seconds, refreshed while inside.
